\section{Hypercontractivity --- Products --- Norms}
%%% generated by the blueprint pipeline from TCSlib.BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.Products.Norms
\subsection*{Hypercontractivity --- Products --- Norms: Introduction}
Finite weighted moment norms satisfy Hölder duality, tail estimates, and estimates for influences and omitted low degree components. The weights in these statements need not form probability distributions.

\subsection*{Hypercontractivity --- Products --- Norms: Results}

\begin{theorem}[Signed power dual identities]
\lean{BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.FiniteNorms.signed_power_dual}
\leanok
\difficulty{5}
For $q>1$ and $z\in\mathbb R$, set $g=z|z|^{q-2}$. Then $zg=|z|^q$ and
$|g|^{q/(q-1)}=|z|^q$.
\end{theorem}

\begin{theorem}[Weighted Hölder inequality]
\lean{BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.FiniteNorms.weighted_holder}
\leanok
\difficulty{5}
Let $I$ be a finite set with weights $w_i\ge0$, and let $p,q$ be Hölder-conjugate real
exponents. For any $f,g:I\to\mathbb R$,
\[
\sum_{i\in I}w_i f_i g_i\le\left(\sum_{i\in I}w_i|f_i|^p\right)^{1/p}\left(\sum_{i\in
I}w_i|g_i|^q\right)^{1/q}.
\]
\end{theorem}

\begin{theorem}[Weighted norm bound from pairings]
\lean{BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.FiniteNorms.norm_le_of_pairing}
\leanok
\uses{BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.FiniteNorms.signed_power_dual}
\difficulty{5}
Let $I$ be a finite set, let $w_i\ge 0$ for each $i\in I$, let $q>1$, let $z:I\to\mathbb
R$, and let $N\ge 0$. If every function $g:I\to\mathbb R$ satisfies
\[
\sum_{i\in I}w_i z_i g_i\le N\left(\sum_{i\in I}w_i|g_i|^{q/(q-1)}\right)^{1/(q/(q-1))},
\]
then $\left(\sum_{i\in I}w_i|z_i|^q\right)^{1/q}\le N$.
\end{theorem}

\begin{theorem}[Contraction from self-adjointness]
\lean{BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.FiniteNorms.selfAdjoint_contraction}
\leanok
\uses{BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.FiniteNorms.norm_le_of_pairing, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.FiniteNorms.weighted_holder}
\difficulty{4}
Let $I$ be a finite set with weights $w_i\ge0$, and let $T$ be an operator from
real-valued functions on $I$ to real-valued functions on $I$. Suppose that $\sum_{i\in
I}w_i(Tf)_i g_i=\sum_{i\in I}w_i f_i(Tg)_i$ for all functions $f,g:I\to\mathbb R$. For
$q>1$, suppose also that
$\left(\sum_iw_i|(Tg)_i|^{q/(q-1)}\right)^{1/(q/(q-1))}\le\left(\sum_iw_i|g_i|^{q/(q-1)}\right)^{1/(q/(q-1))}$
for every $g:I\to\mathbb R$. Then
$\left(\sum_iw_i|(Tf)_i|^q\right)^{1/q}\le\left(\sum_iw_i|f_i|^q\right)^{1/q}$ for every
$f:I\to\mathbb R$.
\end{theorem}

\begin{lemma}[Weighted moment tail bound]
\lean{BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.FiniteNorms.weighted_tail_le_norm_div_rpow}
\leanok
\difficulty{5}
Let $I$ be a finite set with weights $w_i\ge0$, let $f:I\to\mathbb R$, and let $q,c>0$.
Then
\[
\sum_{i\in I}w_i\mathbf 1_{\{c\le|f_i|\}}\le\left(\frac{\left(\sum_{i\in
I}w_i|f_i|^q\right)^{1/q}}{c}\right)^q.
\]
\end{lemma}

\begin{theorem}[Centered absolute-moment estimate]
\lean{BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.FiniteNorms.centered_abs_sum_sq_le}
\leanok
\difficulty{5}
Let $I$ be a finite set, let $w_i\ge0$ for each $i\in I$, and let $g:I\to\mathbb R$
satisfy $\sum_{i\in I}w_i g_i=0$. Then $\left(\sum_{i\in
I}w_i|g_i|\right)^2\le4\left(\sum_{i\in I}w_i g_i^2\right)\left(\sum_{i\in
I:g_i>0}w_i\right)$.
\end{theorem}

\begin{theorem}[Weighted exponential mean inequality]
\lean{BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.FiniteNorms.weighted_rpow_mean_le}
\leanok
\difficulty{4}
Let $I$ be a finite set with weights $w_i\ge0$ and $\sum_{i\in I}w_i>0$. For any
$d:I\to\mathbb R$ and any $\rho>0$,
\[
\left(\sum_{i\in I}w_i\right)\rho^{\left(\sum_{i\in I}w_i d_i\right)/(\sum_{i\in
I}w_i)}\le\sum_{i\in I}w_i\rho^{d_i}.
\]
\end{theorem}

\begin{theorem}[A large term from a three-halves sum]
\lean{BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.FiniteNorms.exists_sq_div_sum_le_of_sum_three_halves}
\leanok
\difficulty{5}
Let $I$ be a finite set and let $a_i\ge0$ for every $i\in I$, with $\sum_{i\in I}a_i>0$.
Suppose $A\ge0$ and $A\le\sum_{i\in I}a_i^{3/2}$. Then some $i\in I$ satisfies
$\left(A/\sum_{j\in I}a_j\right)^2\le a_i$.
\end{theorem}

\begin{theorem}[Weighted low-degree omission bound]
\lean{BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.FiniteNorms.weighted_lowDegree_omission_le}
\leanok
\difficulty{5}
Let $\alpha$ be a finite set, let $E(S)\ge 0$ for every subset $S\subseteq\alpha$, let
$J\subseteq\alpha$, let $k\in\mathbb N$, and let $0\le\rho\le 1$. Then
$\rho^k\sum_{\substack{S\subseteq\alpha\|S|\le k,\ S\nsubseteq
J}}E(S)\le\sum_{i\in\alpha\setminus J}\sum_{S\subseteq\alpha,\ i\in S}\rho^{|S|}E(S)$.
\end{theorem}
